items.topic: South Sudan postpones first national elections until February
items.article: Sat Sri Akal Dosto! Aaj hai 14 November 2026. Aao gall karde haan South Sudan postpones first national elections until February baare. Ajjkal social media ton lai ke chaah de khokheyaan tak ise gall di charcha hai. Hun tak mili jaankari mutabik eh mudda lokan vich kaafi charcha vich hai. Punjab de lokan te isda sidha asar penda hai. Agge ki hovega, eh aoun wale dina vich pata lagega. Tusi is baare ki sochde ho, comment vich zaroor dasso.
